schema_family: claude-root-worker-seam-design (v1 ... v5 key sets retained where still meaningful; v6 adds abi_conventions, material_layout, root_state_record, containment_gaps CG-2 ... CG-4, custody_return_evidence, unknown_route, launch_order, relay_loss, daemon_steps, sub_helper_factory and h_prime)
author: Claude Code lead claude-opus-5-5 (drafting subagent, author role)

acceptance.review: An independent review of v6 is required. The author grants nothing.

design_document.relation: v6 is this file plus the carried v5 slices with R6-1 ... R6-29 applied, and transitively everything those slices carry (v4 C4 slices with R5, then v3, v2, v1), minus W5-1 and W5-2.

companions.hash_cycle: SEAM-DESIGN.md Appendix D binds jackal.json and AUTHOR-NOTES.md; this file binds SEAM-DESIGN.md; the handback records this file's hash.

kept_closed.R5_W5: carried inside C5-B; R6-2 and R6-3 change only the v5 result lines of R5-16 and R5-17 (range repair)

self_containment.rule: Each slice's sha256 is that of the UTF-8 bytes of its v5 lines, each followed by a newline.

P.shape: every argument a pointer and one size_t: record byte size, arena byte length, or roster element count

T.shape: Input pair, Arena pair, (pointer, element count, total byte size) triples, Result pair

abi_conventions.return: 0 written; any other value is a transport refusal (CoreUnavailable)

per_export.X-5: T with output triples and an output-arena pair
per_export.X-8: P plus FactsV2 and Selection pairs before the output

material_layout: WLMP, u16 version 1, u16 export version, u32 count; per parameter u32 index, u8 kind, u64 size word, u64 byte length, bytes; little-endian; sha256 of the whole is m

CG-2.gap: worker-served IP requests run under the WL request's admitted bound
CG-2.closure: each such request runs under its own admitted bound or the daemon service's own

CG-3.gap: later WL requests wait for g+1
CG-3.closure: served concurrently under their own reservation and bound, with no wait for a later generation

CG-4.closure: a genuine full-resource owner adapter; every original owner.retry case served

archive_equal.integer: negative flag and minimal little-endian magnitude hex
archive_equal.float: big-endian binary64 bits of Round with the sign bit from Sign(X)
archive_equal.overflow_lexeme: original ValueError raised by the original check first

custody_return_evidence.R1: worker and namespace-init pidfds terminal (K-24) plus OB-ESC
custody_return_evidence.R2: worker and init identities gone (pidfd_open with recorded start tick) plus fresh exclusive flock on every transferred lock file plus OB-ESC

unknown_route.back_to_service: WORKER_REATTACHED legal in Unknown with a worker Before_Unknown; RECONCILED to Before_Unknown for C-CHANNEL or C-DEADLINE, or C-APPEND by successful replay
unknown_route.worker_while_unknown: no gated mutation; waits at the refused choke point without raising; no transfer; endpoint open

launch_order: launcher and HELD (HELD carries the former PREPARED record content)
no_slot_failure: UNKNOWN appended only in DISPATCH_INTENDED, NAMESPACE_HELD, GO_INTENDED or UNKNOWN, as rw/protected_scoped_resource_runtime.py:770-776

relay_loss.b: use the last authenticated front re-read; continue; only the write is lost

daemon_steps: front: line, router, parse and parse errors, queue, transfer intent; custody owner: progress, capture, retain_client_request, context, mutation lock, invoke, publish, response bytes, REQUEST_RESPONDED; RELAY write by the front; PROGRESS_BYTES frame added

sub_helper_factory.created: forked by the root helper v2 before unshare(CLONE_NEWPID)

h_prime.agents: child tasks of the same request's root
h_prime.decision: lead (author's reading; reviewer to check); any authoritative policy change is D-4a's, none proposed

measurements.K-27: narrowed to kernel memfd seals and mapping (OP-7)
measurements.K-28: PID namespace of forks after unshare (OP-7)
measurements.RC-11: dynamic loader of a sealed memfd (lead)

controls.retained: every original and additive control; none retired

process.writes: Write and Edit only, only in WT/designs/claude-root-worker-seam-design-v6/
process.deviation: carry by hash-pinned slices instead of the preferred inlined composition (AUTHOR-NOTES §6, §7)

non_claims: Nothing is reviewed, accepted, proved or authorized; no approval gate is added.
Nothing was compiled, run, imported, proved, tested or measured.
No equivalence for worker-served IP, later WL requests, or the dispatcher's evidence fields.
R1 custody return does not detect an escaped holder.
